name: Shiba Ryotaro
source:
Vocal Range: Medium-Low
Job: Voice Actor

He's the epitome of masculinity with his big build and ripped muscle. However, in contrast with his appearance, he's clumsy and helpless with direction. In spite of that, he can be really dependable in rare occasions. He's really passionate about his work.
